context: Two students chat in the hallway after PE class
purpose: Teach: 中学校/僕ら/全身/歌い/おしゃべり/笑う/班/ライバル

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 体育の後って、なんか全身がだるくなるよな。
lines.en: After PE class, my whole body just feels heavy, you know?
lines.style: Casual male high schooler, relaxed and a bit tired tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。中学校の時、僕らはもっと元気だった気がするけどな。
lines.en: I get it. Back in middle school, I feel like we had way more energy.
lines.style: Teen boy speaking casually, slightly nostalgic and laid-back tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今日、同じ班だった山田、まじでライバルって感じで本気出してきたよな。
lines.en: Yamada, who was in our group today, came at us seriously like a real rival.
lines.style: Casual male high schooler, half-amused half-impressed tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あいつ走りながら歌い出した時は思わず笑うしかなかったわ。
lines.en: When that guy started singing while running, I couldn't help but laugh.
lines.style: Teen boy laughing as he speaks, amused and animated.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あはは、確かに。俺らのクラスっておしゃべりばっかで本当うるさいよな。
lines.en: Haha, true. Our class is just chatter all the time, seriously so noisy.
lines.style: Casual male high schooler, laughing warmly with friendly tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でもそれが楽しいんじゃん。来週もまた同じ班だといいな。
lines.en: But that's what makes it fun, right? Hope we're in the same group next week too.
lines.style: Teen boy speaking cheerfully and casually, slightly hopeful.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だな。じゃあ次の授業遅れるから、また後でな。
lines.en: Yeah. Anyway, I'll be late for my next class, so catch you later.
lines.style: Casual male high schooler wrapping up, friendly and quick tone.
